Amazement came on all, and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and…
He said to them, “Where is your faith?” Being afraid they marveled, saying to one another, “Who is this then, that he…
Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
A voice of tumult from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of Yahweh that repays his enemies what they deserve.
The sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.

translations.web: Yahweh’s voice is powerful. Yahweh’s voice is full of majesty.
translations.bsb: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.
translations.kjv: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is full of majesty.
translations.asv: The voice of Jehovah is powerful; The voice of Jehovah is full of majesty.
